policy.gptApplication: User authorizes the same ChatGPT plan multiples for every GPT model. Owner decision O45 (2026-10-23), as amended by O88 (2026-10-28): GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra keep their own SemiAnalysis figures on every ChatGPT plan, bound to each model's unsuffixed (max) row because SemiAnalysis names the models without an effort; each of their other efforts (GPT-6.1 Sol at xhigh, high, medium and low, GPT-6 Astra at xhigh and high, ranked as their own rows under O33) takes its own model's figure per plan as a labelled same-model measurement from another effort (O88; measured evidence under O90; an allowance is effort-invariant, O87); every other GPT model takes, per plan, the lower of the two reported model-conditional figures as a labelled user assumption naming its donor route. Routes are one row per model and plan.
policy.routeGranularity: Owner decision O45 (2026-10-23): every route row names exactly one model and one plan.
policy.o72Application: Owner decisions O72-O92 (2026-10-26 to 2026-10-28): after the O71 search found no model × tier with two concordant user reports, the owner-authorised routes stay (the SemiAnalysis selection with its O40/O45 assumptions, the O46 MiMo quota ceilings) and providers without one (Google, Kimi, MiniMax) stay on API fallback. Two concordant user reports replace only an assumption-based or fallback route; an exact controlled measurement keeps precedence (O73) unless a detected change flags it and a concordant pair for the same plan is dated after that change (O78). Admission stays the strict all-reports concordance test (O74); every release runs all three O71 stages over every cell (O75); speed-mode reports convert at the provider's multiplier, flagged (O76); a provider's announcement of a metering change triggers E18 (O77); a change to a shared meter flags every plan on it (O79); a 5-hour figure stays in its own unit and never converts (O80, O82); a provider-documented change splits the partition too (O83); a change detected on any Kimi plan splits every Kimi plan (O84); every report cell is tested, and one on a plan the Plan ranking does not list is evidence only (O85). O86: concordance is the largest lower bound at most 1.20x the smallest upper bound. O87: an allowance is effort-invariant, so reports pool across efforts of one model. O88: a SemiAnalysis figure for a model serves every effort of that model, labelled; O90 counts it as measured evidence. O89: an O88 same-model route shares its donor measurement's precedence and change flag against reports for the same model and plan. O91, O92: a controlled measurement inside an acknowledged accounting-fault window for its plan stays selected and flagged, with the routes resting on it, until two concordant user reports for that plan replace it.

rules: API-priced consumption tied to a meter fraction or to exhaustion of a window; a figure with no meter fraction is a lower bound and does not count

policy.claudeApplication: User authorizes (2026-10-18, Option 2) applying Opus 5.5's measured SemiAnalysis Claude plan multiples to every other Claude model.
